name: Cafés Seoul
description: A web application for discovering cafes in Seoul with advanced multi-criteria filtering that Kakao Map and Naver Map don't offer. Users can browse, rate, review, and submit cafes with a 10-dimension rating system.
goal: Enable users to find the perfect cafe in Seoul by filtering on specific dimensions (seating, wifi quality, food, drinks, lighting, outlets, quietness, price value, comfort) with ratings from 1-5 on each. The app fills a gap left by existing Korean map services which only offer basic search.
coreValue: Multi-criteria filtering with 1-5 ratings on each cafe dimension, allowing users to find exactly the type of cafe they are looking for.
targetAudience: Expats and international visitors in Seoul looking for cafes
Korean locals who want detailed cafe information beyond basic listings
Remote workers and students seeking specific cafe amenities (wifi, outlets, quiet environment)
Cafe enthusiasts who want to discover and rate cafes

languages.implementation: Client-side i18n with cookie-based language persistence, full translation files for all UI strings

stack.framework: Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)

backend.auth: Supabase Auth (email/password, Google OAuth, Kakao OAuth)

cafeDiscovery.description: Browse, search, and filter cafes in Seoul
capabilities: Paginated cafe list with search by name/address
Filter by district, cafe type, price range
Filter by boolean features (wifi, outlets, pet-friendly, laptop-friendly, parking)
Filter by minimum rating on any of 9 dimensions
Detailed cafe profile pages with photos, ratings, and reviews
25 Seoul districts with localized names (ko, en, fr, zh, vi)

interactiveMap.description: Kakao Maps integration with advanced filtering
capabilities: Full-screen interactive map with cafe markers
Cafe info popups with photo, rating, directions link
Color-coded markers (red for favorites, blue for others)

ratingSystem.description: 10-dimension rating system for comprehensive cafe evaluation
features: One rating per user per cafe (upsert pattern)
Automatic aggregate calculation via database triggers

capabilities: Optional text when submitting a rating
My Reviews tab with sorting and filtering
Submit new cafes with Kakao Place search integration
Rate limit: 3 submissions per day per user

photoSystem.description: Photo uploads with moderation and community voting
capabilities: Rate limit: 10 uploads per day per user

authentication.description: Multi-method auth with SSR cookie-based sessions

capabilities: Heart toggle on cafe cards and detail pages
Filter map to show only favorites
Animated spinning wheel to pick a random cafe
Respects all active filters (rating dimensions, features)
District search to limit to a specific area
Weighted random selection (higher-rated cafes more likely)
Direct spin-again without returning to idle state
Get directions link to Kakao Maps
Daily digest email at 9 AM KST via Edge Function + pg_cron
Responsive: mobile card layout + desktop table layout

public.description: Homepage with hero, search bar, roulette CTA, and popular neighborhoods
Cafe listing with search, filters, and pagination
Cafe detail page with photos, ratings, reviews, map
Interactive Kakao Map with filter sidebar

authenticated.description: User profile with tabs (reviews, favorites, submissions)

admin.description: Admin dashboard with stats and recent activity

patterns: Partial indexes for efficient queue queries
Rate limit reset at midnight KST
Upsert pattern with ON CONFLICT for ratings

designPatterns.authentication: Supabase Auth with @supabase/ssr for cookie-based SSR sessions. getUser() (not getSession()) in server code. onAuthStateChange subscription in client components.
designPatterns.serverActions: Next.js Server Actions for all data mutations (ratings, reviews, submissions, photos, favorites, profile updates).
designPatterns.optimisticUI: useTransition + useState + error revert for toggle interactions (favorites, helpful votes).
designPatterns.i18n: Client-side translation with cookie-based language persistence. TranslatedText type (Record<string, string>) for database content. getLocalizedText() helper with fallback chain.
designPatterns.responsiveDesign: Mobile-first approach. 44px touch targets (WCAG AAA). flex-col sm:flex-row for mobile stacking. overflow-x-hidden on body. max-h-[80vh] for mobile panels.
designPatterns.errorHandling: Server Actions return { success, error } objects. Client-side toast notifications via Sonner.
designPatterns.codeOrganization: Feature-based component folders (auth, map, roulette, ratings, reviews, photos, favorites, profile, admin, submissions). Shared UI in components/ui (shadcn).

accessibility.ariaLabels: On interactive elements, sr-only text for screen readers
accessibility.keyboardNavigation: Radix UI primitives provide built-in keyboard support
